environment_constraints: network_mode OPEN_INTERNET (package install + chrome available). GPU is SwiftShader software rasterizer, so absolute FPS is NOT representative — only same-machine before/after deltas are meaningful; state this in docs. No Docker needed (pure npm build). Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that).
contribution_requirements: Commit on a NEW branch off main named motion/interactivity; do NOT push. Never commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/. Keep the WS2 QualityToggle as the ONLY quality control. Route every public/ URL through lib/asset.ts asset(). Keep all WebGL/DOM behind next/dynamic { ssr:false }. Ask before adding any dependency.
key_patterns: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE — interactions must route through the EXISTING logic layer, no parallel state machine, no answers invented in a component (mirrors tireshop's src/brain respond()->reply.intent and useConversation.send()). Findings: (a) Chef+Coach engines lib/{chef,coach}/*Engine.ts expose respondToMessage(history, text) -> { reply, suggestions } — PURE, no React/three. They currently return NO intent/focus metadata. To make camera framing engine-driven WITHOUT a parallel state machine, ADD a small additive optional field (e.g. `intent`/`focus`) to the response type, computed from the SAME branch the engine already took (recipe-steps, ingredient-list, suggest, diet, workout-walkthrough, etc.) — do NOT change how it parses input or the reply text. (b) The ChefChatbot/CoachChatbot `send(text)` callbacks are the single input path; a 3D click must call the SAME send() with a real query string so the engine produces the answer (never answer in the scene). (c) Pet: lib/pet/petState.ts applyAction(state, action) is the state engine; VirtualPet.doAction(action) is the single input path; a 3D click should call doAction (raise a real PetAction). (d) Wardrobe: components/wardrobe/wardrobeOptions.ts OPTIONS is the content; WardrobeBuilder holds selection state + setters; a 3D click should call the SAME selection setter to change a garment. (e) Scenes are FIXED-camera (no OrbitControls except wardrobe turntable). CONSTRAINT: do NOT alter pinned framing constants (AIM_HEIGHT, CAMERA_DISTANCE, AIM_MODEL_FRACTION, MODEL_SCALE, gesture/motion transforms, wardrobe turntable). New camera moves must be LAYERED/animated relative to the established framing (e.g. animate a small camera offset/target nudge, or drei easing), never by rewriting the rest constants. (f) All four scenes already gate heavier extras (GroundBackdrop, rim light) to High via `quality==='high'` and qualitySettings(); any new heavier ambient motion MUST be High-only so Fast frame time does not regress. (g) Tone mapping is ACESFilmic on all four — do NOT change (WS2 measurement-gated). (h) drei ships useCursor (hover), easing helpers, and CameraControls — prefer these over new deps.
